responsibility: Implements the dataflow analysis that determines where symbolic state can be discarded to reduce analyzer state explosion. It walks SSA names, loads, address-taken uses, and local decl accesses across the supergraph, builds per-SSA and per-decl need sets over function_point locations, propagates those requirements backward and forward through CFG and interprocedural boundaries, and provides Graphviz annotation support for dump files showing which names are needed or purged at each point.
same_name_distinction: Contains the actual state-purging analysis over the supergraph—walking GIMPLE uses, propagating neededness across function_point locations, and emitting dump annotations—while state-purge.h primarily declares the map/summaries and annotator types used to represent that analysis.
